synthetic_input_distribution: independent Rademacher coordinates multiplied by sqrt(fixed_second_moment), giving the registered second moment exactly for every sample
router_initialization: fresh torch.nn.Linear(d, 4, bias=True, dtype=float32) immediately after torch.manual_seed(router_seed); this is PyTorch default uniform initialization, then evaluated in float64
radius_quantity: unbounded local affine top-1 L-infinity radius min_j margin_j / ||w_selected-w_j||_1; no pixel clipping and no output certificate
primary_fit: ordinary least squares of log aggregate-median radius on log dimension, separately for each fixed input moment
uncertainty: 2000 deterministic cluster bootstrap replicates resampling the 20 router seeds and recomputing all six aggregate medians
constant_check: report fitted intercepts and the ratio of radii between the two fixed-moment families; do not tune either moment after observation
claim_boundary: A synthetic standard-initialization mechanism check against a two-point-fit objection. It is not a universal law, an exact clipped-box route boundary, a third dataset, or an output-robustness certificate.
